products.name: Devin (Cognition)
products.note: Autonomous software engineer; full codebase access; high decision-influence; security critical

profile_text.body:
Cognition is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as a team of interdisciplinary makers working on what it calls the biggest shift in computing since the invention of software, and it focuses on autonomous AI systems for software engineering.

Cognition's primary product is Devin, which the company describes as the first autonomous software engineer. Devin is designed to plan, write, test, and ship production code within existing workflows, and the site's held data classifies it as security critical given its full codebase access and high degree of decision-making influence. Cognition also tracks Windsurf, an AI-integrated development environment in the coding and developer tools category, which the site notes involves source-code exposure.

The held facts associate Cognition with 139 legal cases tied to California jurisdiction, though no specific litigation details are recorded in the available data. No patent filings, SEC disclosures, or MCP server registrations are on file for the company at this time.
